name: Phone and tablet logic board
notes: Dense surface-mount board under metal shields. Almost nothing on it can be reused by hand; the value is the working phone or tablet as a whole. The battery sits separately.

comps.spec: Application processor (system-on-chip) under a metal shield
Flash storage and RAM chips (data may still be readable)
comps.loc: Beside or stacked on the processor

comps.spec: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and (phones) cellular radio chips
comps.loc: Under shields near the board ends

comps.spec: Power-management chip and tiny buck converters
Single-cell lithium charge circuit, 5V USB input
Tiny crystals (32.768 kHz clock and radio reference)
Accelerometer, gyro, compass and pressure sensor chips
USB port, SIM and card tray, flex-cable connectors
